 Martim Fernandes likely on left for Francesco Farioli against Gil Vicente 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article FC Porto ’s trip to Gil Vicente in the Primeira Liga is expected to see Martim Fernandes return to the starting line-up. The young full-back looks likely to be chosen on the left side of defence.
 After being a substitute in the Champions League defeat to PSV, Martim Fernandes could return to the starting line-up in a position he last started in during the derby against Benfica.
 OneFootball Videos
 This potential change fits with the rotation policy Francesco Farioli has adopted between matches. Since the start of the season, the Italian coach has named an unchanged starting eleven for consecutive games only once, against Arouca and Académico de Viseu.
